o.text: From Arabic فَعَلَة (faʕala), plural of فَاعِل (fāʕil). The /h/ is a rather recent addition replacing the long /æ/ that emerged in place of the Arabic /aʕa/ sequence.

From Proto-Turkic *ïrmak~*yïrmak (“river”). Perhaps ultimately from Proto-Turkic *ār-~*ar-~*ïr- (“to flow”), whence also Azerbaijani arx (“irrigation ditch”). Also cognate with Chuvash ҫырма (śyrma) and Turkish ırmak.
From mərkəzə (“dative of mərkəz (“center”)”) + qaç- (“to run”) + -ma.
